edit.description: both attempt keyers on the `.` subpath
doc blocks now reachable from the map's `.d.ts`

summary: Ship `entryAttemptKey`/`recordAttemptKey` on the package's public surface, so a chain reading `TickContext.priorAttempts` takes the engine's own join.

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: Both keyers resolve through the package's `.` subpath; nothing outside the engine has to compose `<keyspace>:<slug>` for itself.
tests: the package's public surface spells the prior-attempt map key for an entry
the package's public surface spells the prior-attempt map key for a record
notes: `entryAttemptKey`'s own doc already names the outside reader — a consumer asking which queue entries a refusal still stands against — and with two subpaths (`.`, `./harness`) that reader cannot import it. Either the claim is residue or the surface is short the re-export; this is the latter call. Raised by the build note on THE-ENGINE-KEYS-A-PRIOR-ATTEMPT-RECORD.

summary: `docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md` tells a chain author "the four built-ins above are all `shellGate` instances" over five bullets, three of which `shellGate` composes.

per.section: Narration is the ladder's bottom rung

acceptance: The built-in list names which built-ins `shellGate` composes instead of counting them, and a pin resolves that naming against `src/builtinGates.ts`.
tests: docs/CHAIN-AUTHORING.md names exactly the built-in gates shellGate composes
notes: `writablePathsGate` and `pendingGate` sit in the same bullet run and are not `shellGate`-built; `tscGate`/`vitestGate`/`eslintGate` are, through `pkgManagerGate`, and carry `command` as the evidence. Raised by the build note on THE-GATE-SET-CARDINAL-SHRINKS-TO-THE-PIN, which retired the same defect over the discipline gates.

edit.description: the three walk describes become callers
home for the shared reader, beside `sectionOf`/`walkOf`

summary: The supervisor-policy, adoption-price and gate-section walks spell one sequence three times — checker over one module, vacuity wrapper, anchored section — at ~90 lines each.
acceptance: One reader takes module, interface, vacuity member and heading anchor and yields the declared set plus the anchored section; the three describes call it, and every case keeps its title and its verdict.
notes: Target shape named by the build note on THE-SUPERVISOR-POLICY-SECTION-NAMES-ITS-KNOBS-ONCE. A fourth walk copies whichever is nearest, as eight `sectionOf` copies did before `docSections.ts`. Behavior-free: the typecheck and the three describes' own cases hold it.
